message:
Intercare has 26 WC adjuster roles open right now. That usually means claim volume is climbing faster than the team can process it.

Brighterway automates the manual work that slows adjusters down. It reads emails, pulls documents, fills claim system fields, and flags what is missing. It works inside the systems you already use.

Worth a look?
